def test_allreduce_byte_count_matches_formula(self):
        """Ring allreduce per-rank bytes = 2 * T * (N - 1) / N."""

original_quiz.question: What is the per-rank bandwidth cost of ring allreduce for a tensor of T bytes on N ranks?
original_quiz.explanation: Ring allreduce moves N-1 chunks of size T/N twice (reduce-scatter then allgather); the per-rank total is 2T(N-1)/N, independent of cluster size.

original_quiz.source_correct_option: 2T(N-1)/N bytes

original_quiz.question: Why is the queue mesh in this lesson an honest stand-in for NCCL on a real cluster?
options: It implements the same wire pattern (ordered point-to-point sends around a ring), only the medium differs
original_quiz.explanation: Algorithmic correctness depends on the wire pattern, not the medium; the queue ring exposes the same race shapes and chunk schedule as NCCL ring allreduce.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2，保留消息模式用于算法推理；Queue不证明NCCL硬件/网络race、性能或生产故障行为完全相同。

original_quiz.question: After the reduce-scatter half of ring allreduce, what does rank r hold?
options: The reduced sum for one chunk (one Nth of the tensor)
The reduced sum for two chunks
original_quiz.explanation: Reduce-scatter parks the sum of one chunk on one rank; the allgather half then rotates those completed chunks around the ring.

original_quiz.question: Why use tree broadcast instead of N-1 direct sends from the source?
options: Trees double the holder set per round; depth is log2(N) so latency scales as log not N
original_quiz.explanation: log2(N) hops dominate when latency per hop is the bottleneck; N-1 sequential sends pay that latency floor N times.

true_h2_h4.heading: Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 学习目标是broadcast初态和mean gradient同步，再比较同数据reference；源码没有实现声明的hook/bucket/overlap，证明范围按tests降级。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Problem
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 数据并行复制模型并划分data，需同步梯度/初态/optimizer时钟；它不分片模型状态，不必解决模型单卡放不下。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Concept
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Mermaid显示初始broadcast、own shard F/B、ring式grad bucket与step；实际同步逐参数阻塞，没有图中的bucket异步重叠。

true_h2_h4.heading: The three operations DDP needs
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 初始化params broadcast、grad SUM/mean和按需buffers同步是不同阶段；本wrapper只前两项，BN buffer与局部统计另处理。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why mean and not sum
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 等大同权本地mean经SUM/W等global mean；不等rank sample/token应权重归约，world增大不保证原lr或优化质量无需调整。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why bucket gradients
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 分桶以一次较大通信摊薄固定启动开销，bucket大小权衡就绪时间/重叠与内存；本例并未将全部grad打成单bucket。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why pin the seed
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 相同初始参数可由seed或broadcast保证，数据sampler需无遗漏/无意重复和epoch合同；同seed必漂移、rank seed必须的断言过强。

true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 完整读MiniMLP、薄wrapper、synthetic generator、spawn/file workers、顺序reference和main；reference只输出rank0loss及final norm。

true_h2_h4.heading: Production patterns in the wild
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: unused/static_graph/no_sync是生产实现能力，条件分支需collective顺序一致；固定10x throughput不是定律；本课没有这些实现。

true_h2_h4.heading: Use It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: PyTorch/Accelerate/Megatron是组合入口，需实际backend/设备/版本选择；本课CPU gloo不等CPU复现NCCL/NVLink性能。

original_quiz.question: Why does DDP broadcast parameters at construction instead of relying on the same seed across ranks?
options: Same-seed init drifts by float epsilon across ranks; broadcast guarantees byte-equal weights before training starts
original_quiz.explanation: Float ops on different hardware (or even different process orders) can differ at the bit level. A broadcast from rank 0 is the only way to get byte-equal weights everywhere.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确3，broadcast确保初态同步；同seed必漂float和broadcast唯一保证均不成立，用完整参数初态合同解释。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Same-seed init drifts by float epsilon across ranks; broadcast guarantees byte-equal weights before training starts

original_quiz.question: What does DDP do after backward and before optimizer.step?
options: Allreduce-SUM every parameter's gradient and divide by world_size to get the mean gradient
original_quiz.explanation: The mean gradient is invariant to world_size so a learning rate tuned at one rank works at N ranks.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确0，在源码backward后SUM/W；rank等有效目标权重才对应全局mean，不保证增卡后lr/质量不变。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Allreduce-SUM every parameter's gradient and divide by world_size to get the mean gradient

original_quiz.question: Why divide by world_size after allreduce-SUM instead of using allreduce-MEAN?
options: Allreduce-MEAN does not exist in gloo
Division by world_size on each rank is a local op; allreduce-MEAN would be implemented the same way under the hood
original_quiz.explanation: Both approaches yield the same arithmetic. NCCL ships allreduce-AVG since 2.10; gloo does not, so divide locally after SUM.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2，SUM后本地除W可实现mean；后端AVG支持及数值顺序有条件，不写成所有API的实现事实。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Division by world_size on each rank is a local op; allreduce-MEAN would be implemented the same way under the hood

original_quiz.question: What does gradient bucketing in production DDP achieve?
options: Coalesces many small allreduces into one large allreduce, amortising the per-call latency floor
original_quiz.explanation: A 1B-parameter model has thousands of grad tensors; one allreduce per tensor pays gloo or NCCL latency thousands of times.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确0，融合小collective摊薄启动延迟；源码无bucket/overlap，图不作已实现证据。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Coalesces many small allreduces into one large allreduce, amortising the per-call latency floor

original_quiz.question: Why does no_sync() exist in PyTorch DDP?
options: Gradient accumulation over K microbatches needs to skip the post-backward allreduce for K-1 of them; no_sync wraps that pause
original_quiz.explanation: Without no_sync the allreduce fires K times per accumulated step and throughput drops to the floor.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确3，前K−1micro暂停同步；还需forward+backward范围、末同步、正确有效count归一，不保证固定速度。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Gradient accumulation over K microbatches needs to skip the post-backward allreduce for K-1 of them; no_sync wraps that pause

original_quiz.question: Why does this lesson's reference implementation walk every rank's micro-batch sequentially in one process?
options: It is the only way to use gloo
It gives a byte-equal baseline: the sequential mean gradient must equal DDP's allreduced mean gradient at every step
original_quiz.explanation: Equivalence to the reference loop is the load-bearing correctness test; without it gradient sync bugs hide until step 10000.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确3，same-data顺序mean梯度baseline可比较；实际输出rank0loss+finalnorm并不证明每step全params byte-equal。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: It gives a byte-equal baseline: the sequential mean gradient must equal DDP's allreduced mean gradient at every step

true_h2_h4.heading: Stages of ZeRO
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: ZeRO1分O、2加G、3加P；本示例完整grad常驻，后裁零值不释放存储，不等ZeRO2生命周期；生产FSDP配置另核。

true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 只需要本地grad shard时reduce-scatter省后半allgather；两阶段总带宽相近需同等tensor大小/dtype和算法，单reduce-scatter不是allreduce同字节。

options: Optimiser state is the largest memory term and is only touched during the step, not forward or backward
original_quiz.explanation: For Adam in mixed precision the fp32 master plus two moments is 12P bytes per rank vs 4P for fp16 params + grads. Sharding the biggest term first wins the most memory per unit complexity.

original_quiz.question: What is the per-step wire pattern of ZeRO stage 1?
options: One reduce_scatter on gradients plus one allgather on updated parameters
original_quiz.explanation: Reduce_scatter delivers each rank only its gradient shard; allgather distributes the updated parameter shards back. Total bytes equal allreduce, memory is divided by N.

options: Allreduce equals reduce_scatter plus allgather in bandwidth; ZeRO splits that into two halves on different data
original_quiz.explanation: Ring allreduce is implemented as reduce_scatter then allgather. ZeRO does the same two operations but the allgather rotates the updated parameters, not the summed gradient.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确3仅同长度/dtype ring载荷假设；single reduce-scatter是allreduce一半，actual params gather FP32与理论FP16不同。

true_h2_h4.heading: Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 目标GPipe fill-drain、bubble与1F1B/分层负载；源码虚拟schedule+两rank串行wire分开评价。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Problem
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: PP将层分stage并传激活/梯度；140GB只为70B FP16裸weights，内存不一定线性降因stage不均/activation/临时存储。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Concept
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Mermaid四rank顺向activation、逆向backward；图不证明事件合法或资源不重叠，实际two-rank wire只有一个micro在途。

true_h2_h4.heading: GPipe schedule
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 均衡且等时F/B零通信fill-drain总2(M+N−1)，idle fraction(N−1)/(M+N−1)；SOURCE constants B=2未参与schedule，未测wallclock。

true_h2_h4.heading: 1F1B schedule
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 1F1B各stage按位置warmup再交错F/B，减少待反向activation；不是所有场景bubble相等或无权重版本约束的PipeDream泛化。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why equal compute per stage matters
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 按真实kernel、通信与activation测stage成本比按参数数均分可靠；FLOPs不是wallclock唯一依据，具体旗标需核当前。

true_h2_h4.heading: Microbatch versus batch
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: M×B是单DP副本等大完整micro时样本数，通常还乘DP组大小；等权mean loss需要除M，本two-rank源码未除。

true_h2_h4.heading: Build It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 完整读bubble closed form、GPipe schedule、Gantt renderer/slots measure、StageMLP、send/recv workers与runner；后者非GPipe实训。

true_h2_h4.heading: Production patterns in the wild
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: checkpoint可用重算降低activation，partition应实测；send/recv次序必须满足依赖与匹配，偶奇规则不是所有拓扑通则。

true_h2_h4.heading: Use It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 生产Megatron/DeepSpeed组合需组定义，旧torch.distributed.pipeline.sync.Pipe不作当前唯一API指南。

true_h2_h4.heading: Ship It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 80/81连接是教材意图；81实际无PP，checkpoint不保存stage shard，本批不得声称三种并行完整集成。

true_h2_h4.heading: Exercises
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 五练习分别1F1B、balance、gradient equivalence、checkpoint tradeoff与PP×DP；现有06章GPipe/1F1B例复用。

true_h2_h4.heading: Key Terms
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Bubble是idle/(total)、micro为独立F/B单元、GPipe全F后B、1F1B交错；bounded activation仍依深度/策略/重算。

original_quiz.question: What is the pipeline bubble?
options: Idle time at start and end of the pipeline: stages with no work until the first microbatch reaches them, and after the last microbatch leaves
original_quiz.explanation: With M microbatches and N stages, per-stage bubble is (N-1)/(M+N-1). Picking M much greater than N shrinks it.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2，bubble是idle time；fraction式需均衡F/B与零comm条件，不是任意真系统公式。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Idle time at start and end of the pipeline: stages with no work until the first microbatch reaches them, and after the last microbatch leaves

original_quiz.question: Why is GPipe's activation memory proportional to M?
options: All M microbatches' activations must be held until the matching backward; nothing frees until the drain begins
original_quiz.explanation: GPipe fills the pipeline with all forwards before any backward. Each in-flight microbatch carries its activations until its backward starts.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确3，fill-drain保存各micro待反向activation，checkpoint/具体autograd策略可改变实际峰值。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: All M microbatches' activations must be held until the matching backward; nothing frees until the drain begins

original_quiz.question: How does 1F1B improve over GPipe?
options: Same bubble but bounded activation memory; once mb 0's forward reaches the last stage, its backward begins and activations free
original_quiz.explanation: Megatron-LM and PipeDream use 1F1B to bound activation memory by pipeline depth, not microbatch count.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确1，标准同步1F1B在简单模型同bubble而lowerliveactivation；并非所有PipeDream版本与不均衡情况通则。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Same bubble but bounded activation memory; once mb 0's forward reaches the last stage, its backward begins and activations free

original_quiz.question: Why is equal compute per stage more important than equal parameter count?
options: The slowest stage gates every cycle; other stages idle waiting for it. Embedding layers have many parameters but little compute, so partitioning by parameter count misbalances the pipeline
original_quiz.explanation: Megatron-LM exposes --num-layers-per-stage as a list to allow uneven layer counts when per-layer cost differs.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2，最忙stage约束吞吐，按真实时间/通信/内存profile；embedding是否littlecompute依负载。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: The slowest stage gates every cycle; other stages idle waiting for it. Embedding layers have many parameters but little compute, so partitioning by parameter count misbalances the pipeline

original_quiz.question: What goes wrong if every stage calls send before recv?
options: Deadlock on the wire; standard fix is to interleave even-rank send-first and odd-rank recv-first
original_quiz.explanation: Synchronous send/recv pairs need one side to be receiving when the other sends. The lesson schedules ranks explicitly so the pattern is visible.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2是某种阻塞环的风险，发送未必所有拓扑必deadlock，需验证整体P2P匹配依赖而非固定偶奇。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Deadlock on the wire; standard fix is to interleave even-rank send-first and odd-rank recv-first

original_quiz.question: Pipeline plus ZeRO-1 combines what two memory wins?
options: Per-stage parameter sharding (each rank only holds one stage of layers) plus per-rank optimiser sharding (each rank only holds 1/N of optimiser state for its stage)
original_quiz.explanation: Pipeline shards layers across ranks; ZeRO shards optimiser state within the data-parallel group at each pipeline rank. Both wins compound.
original_quiz.chinese_judgment: 源正确2，PP分层+对应DP组ZeRO分状态，可组合；1/N指stage的DP组不是全部world。
original_quiz.source_correct_option: Per-stage parameter sharding (each rank only holds one stage of layers) plus per-rank optimiser sharding (each rank only holds 1/N of optimiser state for its stage)

true_h2_h4.heading: Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 目标manifest记录所有权、hash与明确resume拒绝；本例roundtrip只有param，原子性及continuation目标没有完整验证。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Problem
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: per-rank IO可减rank0瓶颈，但本实现单进程顺序存列表；TB级4h→4min和64倍不是读取代码后的实测结果。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Concept
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Mermaid tmp shards→manifest→rename all是意图；实现多个os.replace逐文件提交，图中的all-at-once含义不成立。

true_h2_h4.heading: Manifest schema
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Manifest world/schema/step/shards rank/path/hash/offset/numel是布局合同；loader却不核offset区间、numel、shape与内部状态一致。

true_h2_h4.heading: Atomic write
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 单file tmp+fsync+replace保证名字原子可见，不保证同目录多file更新事务；新immutable generation核齐后pointer publish才保旧。

true_h2_h4.heading: Three failure modes the schema must defend against
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 源码核world/schema/count/rankunique/path存在与hash；tests只wrong-world/hash/missing manifest，不覆盖缺shard/duplicate/path/shape多分支。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why per-rank files, not one big file
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 多个文件有机会并行/striping；锁、IO与元数据成本须实测，不能固定断言所有生产都同一layout。

options: All state passes through rank 0; write bandwidth is the slowest single link, not the aggregate, so a TB-scale write takes hours

original_quiz.question: Why write to <name>.tmp and rename instead of writing directly?
options: POSIX rename within a filesystem is atomic: a crash mid-write leaves the previous file untouched. Direct writes can leave half-finished checkpoints that poison the next resume
original_quiz.explanation: Without atomic write a partial save plus an updated manifest pointing at it corrupts state on the next load.

original_quiz.question: What does sha256 per shard defend against?
options: Partial or corrupted writes; verifying the hash on load catches truncated shards before they touch model state
original_quiz.explanation: Without sha256 verification a truncated shard loads silently and corrupts the optimiser, surfacing later as NaN loss.

original_quiz.explanation: The cross-world-size rebalance is a separate operation; silently splicing wrong sized shards corrupts state.

original_quiz.question: Why does production rotate checkpoints (keep last K)?
options: Without rotation the disk fills mid-run and the next checkpoint fails; rotation deletes the oldest before writing the new one, bounding disk usage
original_quiz.explanation: Real runs keep 3-5 recent checkpoints; the oldest is dropped before each new save so the disk budget is fixed.

true_h2_h4.heading: Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 目标组合广播/ZeRO/存储，限定20step；源码实为复制模块的CPU synthetic GPT，未执行，不代表学员完成或生产训练。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Problem
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 组合正确性独立于单元正确；正文四invariants比test更强，loss不测单调，参数只final norm，hashroundtrip不测crash原子。

true_h2_h4.heading: The Concept
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Mermaid训练loop+step10checkpoint是静态意图；source实际每rank全model+部分optim通过allgather后rank0顺序存。

true_h2_h4.heading: The mini GPT
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 两block/e32/head4/v64/S16，tokpos+pre-LN masked attention+FFN+untiedhead；29824参数可手算，mask构造CPU不支持直接CUDA搬移。

true_h2_h4.heading: The composition rules
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 初态broadcast一次，ZeRO SUM/W owns gradient同步不另DDP allreduce；checkpoint把bytes allgather给所有rank，loop知道step10规则。

true_h2_h4.heading: Why a tiny GPT and not just an MLP
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: Attention/embedding/CE引入shape与数值边界；LayerNorm有weight/bias却无running stats，source quiz误述；无普通single-rankbaseline。

true_h2_h4.heading: Self-terminating means exit 0
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 固定steps是有限预算，不保证无deadlock/正确；父queue timeout与exitcode检查、异常rank协调和state断言需另做。

true_h2_h4.heading: Build It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 完整读causal attention/block/GPT、flat helpers/Adam state、简化checkpoint、bytegather、workers/runner/verify/main；verify只master。

true_h2_h4.heading: Production patterns in the wild
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 墙钟cadence需安全更新边界和损失窗口；NaN/clip/spike检测要定义policy与原因，源码未实现guard，2x/10min不是普遍阈值。

true_h2_h4.heading: Use It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 生产DeepSpeed/FSDP/Megatron组合依group/backend当前配置；toy不等完整tensor/PP/activation checkpoint或集群吞吐复现。

true_h2_h4.heading: Ship It
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 六课可做协议练习，未证明每失败模式或真实大规模训练；源测试通过也不会推出用户具备独立分布式能力。

true_h2_h4.heading: Exercises
true_h2_h4.chinese_explanation: 五练习TP split、等4micro累积、真实resume continuation、JSONL与forced rollback；其中resume continuation正是现源码缺项。
